# Gypsophila Photography

> A photography studio in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong, specialising in maternity, newborn, 100 days and
> family portraits. Natural, warm images of the moments a family wants to keep.

Last updated: 2026-09-17

## About the business
- Name: Gypsophila Photography (Chinese: 滿天星攝影 / Gypsophila Photo)
- Type: professional photography studio
- Location: TML Tower, Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong
- Area served: all of Hong Kong (Hong Kong Island, Kowloon, New Territories). At-home newborn
  sessions are available; remote districts and the outlying islands by arrangement. All other
  services are shot at the Tsuen Wan studio.
- Formats: studio sessions in Tsuen Wan; newborn sessions can be shot at your home (+$1,000, newborn only)
- Languages: Cantonese and English (site in Traditional Chinese at / and English at /en/)
- Studio: mountain-view studio in Tsuen Wan (floor-to-ceiling glass, natural light, hills behind)
  and an in-house home-style set
- Currency: Hong Kong dollars (HKD)
- Opening hours: 08:00 to 18:00, Monday to Sunday
- By appointment, arranged over Instagram DM

## Site structure (one page per service)
- Home (Traditional Chinese): https://www.gypphoto.com/
- Home (English): https://www.gypphoto.com/en/
- Maternity: https://www.gypphoto.com/en/maternity/ | https://www.gypphoto.com/maternity/
- Newborn: https://www.gypphoto.com/en/newborn/ | https://www.gypphoto.com/newborn/
- 100 Days: https://www.gypphoto.com/en/100-days/ | https://www.gypphoto.com/100-days/
- Family: https://www.gypphoto.com/en/family/ | https://www.gypphoto.com/family/

Each service page carries that service's portfolio, three packages and what they include, the
add-on list, how the session runs, and the FAQ for that service. The home page carries the brand
introduction, the full portfolio, the full rate card and client review screenshots (each transcribed).

## Maternity (/en/maternity/)
- From HKD 2,800 (Essential) | HKD 4,800 (Premium) | HKD 5,800 (Signature)
- Best time to shoot: 28 to 32 weeks
- Styles: natural, black and white, and Korean Pantone, mixed to taste
- Every package includes hair and makeup for the mother, dad in frame at no charge, and gown
  rental (2 to 4 outfits depending on the package)
- Sets: mountain-view studio in Tsuen Wan, and the home-style set (Premium and above: any set,
  mountain view included)
- Session length: 45 / 90 / 120 minutes depending on the package
- Add-ons: weekends and public holidays +$500, extra retouched image +$100 each,
  extra person in frame, pets included, +$300 each

## Newborn (/en/newborn/)
- From HKD 3,800 (Essential) | HKD 4,800 (Premium) | HKD 5,800 (Signature)
- Best time to shoot: 7 to 14 days after birth, while babies are still soft-jointed and sleep deeply
- Formats: at your home (+$1,000) or at the Tsuen Wan studio in TML Tower; some of the larger
  prop set-ups are studio only
- Booking: you can put a deposit down before the birth and fix the date once the baby arrives
- Add-ons: 1-hour professional hair and makeup +$500 each, weekends and public holidays +$500,
  extra retouched image +$100 each, extra person in frame, pets included, +$300 each

## 100 Days (/en/100-days/)
- From HKD 3,800 (Essential) | HKD 4,800 (Premium) | HKD 5,800 (Signature)
- Covers: 100 days, first birthday, the grabbing ceremony (zhuazhou) and cake smash
- Sets: a range of themed sets and props at the Tsuen Wan studio
- Add-ons: 1-hour professional hair and makeup +$500 each, weekends and public holidays +$500,
  extra retouched image +$100 each, extra person in frame, pets included, +$300 each

## Family (/en/family/)
- From HKD 2,800 (Essential) | HKD 4,800 (Premium) | HKD 5,800 (Signature)
- Covers: full family portraits, parent and child, three generations, and graduation portraits
- Group size: the studio holds about 20 people; packages cover up to 10, +$300 for each additional person
- Pets are welcome, +$300 each
- Add-ons: 1-hour professional hair and makeup +$500 each, weekends and public holidays +$500,
  extra retouched image +$100 each

## What is included
- Hair and makeup, and maternity gown rental
- Every image is colour graded; packages also include a set number of fully retouched images
- Pets are welcome
- The studio holds about 20 people, so large family portraits work
- Severe weather (black rainstorm signal or typhoon signal 8 and above): one free reschedule.
  Tell us at least two hours before your shoot time (for maternity, before your makeup call time).
